en: A vintage religious-themed postcard featuring a large, detailed white flower bouquet (likely a rose and lilies of the valley) lying over a grey Christian cross. To the left is an ornate, decorative script quotation in Swedish, with flourishes around the first letter. The background is a muted light green with a thin double-line border. The initials "E.F.S." appear in the lower left corner.
